visual.alt: Cross-section of a single-slope solar still, with a numbered key below the drawing. On the left a tilted plane mirror on a frame stands behind the still (1). A sheet of glass slopes from the tall back wall down to the low front wall (2). The still sits in a box whose base is dimensioned along the bottom (3), and the gap between the outer and inner wall faces is hatched to show the lining (4). A raised tank on the right feeds water through a pipe into the still (5). Mirrors are drawn on the inner face of the back wall (6). Inside, an open tray with a dark floor holds a shallow, dashed water layer; the tray depth is dimensioned on its right side (7) and the gap between two upright fins on its floor is dimensioned above them (8). Three points marked x - one in the outside air, one in the space under the glass and one in the water - show where temperature was measured (9). A channel runs along the lower edge of the glass and a short pipe leads from it into a vessel standing on the ground (10).

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 1: the external reflector is a plane mirror of (1) ........ mounted on a movable steel frame behind the still
items.evidence: Outside, a separate plane mirror of 0.60 square metres, also 5 millimetres thick, was mounted on a movable steel frame standing behind the still.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says the mirror mounted outside on the movable steel frame measured 0.60 square metres, so that is the area for blank 1.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 2: the transparent cover is a single sheet of glass (2) ........ thick
items.evidence: Because the glass had to slope, the box was not a plain rectangle: its back wall stood 0.87 metres high while the front wall was only 0.254 metres, so that the transparent cover, a single sheet of glass 8 millimetres thick, rested at an inclination of 30 degrees.
items.explanation: Paragraph B describes the transparent cover as a single sheet of glass 8 millimetres thick; the thickness goes in blank 2.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 3: the still sits inside a wooden box with a base area of (3) ........
items.evidence: The still they assembled sat inside a wooden box with a base area of 1.08 square metres.
items.explanation: The first sentence of paragraph B gives the wooden box a base area of 1.08 square metres, which is the figure for blank 3.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 4: every outer surface of the box is lined with a layer of (4) ........
items.evidence: Every outer surface was lined with a 2.54-centimetre layer of thermocole, an expanded plastic insulation whose only job is to stop heat leaking out through the walls and floor before the water can use it.
items.explanation: Paragraph B names the expanded plastic insulation lining every outer surface as thermocole, so blank 4 takes that word.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 5: water reaches the basin from a feed tank made of (5) ........
items.evidence: Water reached the basin from a feed tank made of galvanised iron, 0.37 square metres in area and 30.48 centimetres tall, mounted 0.91 metres above the still so that gravity alone kept the basin topped up as distillation drew the level down.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the feed tank supplying the basin was made of galvanised iron; that material fills blank 5.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 6: the mirrors fixed to the side and back walls inside the box are (6) ........ thick
items.evidence: Inside the box, mirrors 5 millimetres thick were fixed to the side and back walls; these internal reflectors catch rays that would otherwise fall on the wooden walls and turn them back down onto the water.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says the mirrors fixed to the side and back walls inside the box were 5 millimetres thick, which is the answer to blank 6.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 7: the basin is a black-painted aluminium tray (7) ........ deep
items.evidence: Inside the box lay the basin, an aluminium tray of exactly one square metre and 20.32 centimetres deep, painted black so that it would absorb as much of the incoming radiation as possible instead of reflecting it away.
items.explanation: Paragraph C gives the black-painted aluminium basin a depth of 20.32 centimetres, so that measurement belongs in blank 7.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 8: the fins on the floor of the basin stand in rows spaced (8) ........ apart
items.evidence: Sixty-four aluminium fins, each 6.35 centimetres tall and 2 millimetres across, stood upright in rows spaced 10.16 centimetres apart.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the upright fins stood in rows spaced 10.16 centimetres apart; the spacing, not the height of the fins, fills blank 8.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 9: the temperatures of the outside air, the basin water and the space under the glass were recorded by (9) ........
items.evidence: K-type thermocouples recorded the temperature of the outside air, of the water in the basin and of the enclosed space under the glass, while the flask was emptied and measured at the end of each hour.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says the three temperatures were recorded by K-type thermocouples, which is what the three marked points stand for.

items.prompt: Diagram (Passage A19) - label 10: from the channel a short outlet pipe carries the distillate into a (10) ........
items.evidence: The slope then does the moving: droplets slide down the inner face into a channel along the lower edge, and from that channel a short outlet pipe carries the distillate into a calibrated flask.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the outlet pipe leads from the channel into a calibrated flask, so blank 10 takes the name of that vessel.

notes: 2026-08-18 sifirdan yeniden yazildi (B3 FAZ 1). Eski hali dort GT duyuru metnine (G01-G04) bagli dort ayri diyagramdi; hepsi tek akademik metne (A19, gunes enerjili damitma duzenegi) tasindi. Kalem sayisi ve numaralar degismedi (10 kalem, 1-10). passage_id grup ve kalem duzeyinde yazili, dosya duzeyinde null (PLAN-EK-kurallar.md 6). Paragraf yuku: B 3, C 2, D 1, E 2, F 1, G 1 - her kalem ayri kanit cumlesinden. A, H, I paragraflari bu pakete dokunmuyor. Kor sinama: metinsiz tahmin edilebilir iki cevap degistirildi - cam ortunun 30 derecelik egimi (gunes duzeneklerinde egim = enlem sezgisiyle bilinebiliyordu) yerine camin 8 mm kalinligi; besleme suyunun litrede 35 gram tuz derisimi (deniz suyu derisimi olarak genel kultur) yerine ic yansiticilarin 5 mm kalinligi.
